$comment: Single source of truth for the Input OTP API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: Enter a one-time code, one box per character.
thumb: 4821

groups.description: Split the boxes into groups, e.g. [3, 3].

value / defaultValue.description: The code typed so far. Use onValueChange; onComplete fires when every box is filled.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Six digits in two groups. Paste a code or let the phone fill it from an SMS. In HTML, add data-vin-otp and include vinui.js.

examples.title: Error and disabled
examples.description: An error outlines every box and is read out with the field.

a11y: One real text input (not six), so screen readers, paste, password managers and SMS autofill (autocomplete="one-time-code") all work.
The boxes are drawn for sight only and hidden from screen readers; the input carries the value.
inputmode="numeric" brings up the number pad on phones.
The input has a label; errors set aria-invalid and are linked with aria-describedby.
